recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not restore Observation.valueReference, Observation.component.valueReference, valueCanonical, or their search parameters under FHIR-40292; future MolecularDefinition linkage should proceed through the later additional-resources/extension work.
issue_request: FHIR-40292 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested valueReference(Any) on Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x], with use-case language and matching search parameters.
initial_application: The seed was historically applied: commit 398f7536 added Reference(MolecularSequence), canonical, value-reference, value-canonical, component-value-reference, and component-value-canonical; Jira comment commit c09d2d2 cleaned the component-value-canonical search-parameter entry.
additional_context: FHIR-40560 removed canonical from both Observation value choices before R5 publication. R6 work replaced MolecularSequence references with MolecularDefinition, then FHIR-52253/FHIR-52453/FHIR-53610 moved the design away from core valueReference/search-parameter support as MolecularDefinition shifted toward additional-resource/IG handling. The current Observation source and search-parameter bundle reflect that later trail.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Re-adding the old FHIR-40292 types or search parameters would contradict later decisions and current authoritative XML; the only stale-looking remaining artifact is observation.svg, a generated-looking diagram that should not be edited alone.
